rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for bone, including bone tissue, an individual bone, and a fishbone when the context is clear.

example.english: I fell and broke a bone in my leg.
example.traditional: 我跌親隻腳，仲整斷咗條骨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dit3 can1 zek3 goek3 zung6 zing2 dyun6 zo2 tiu4 gwat1

rows.note: Use this when you want to make clear that the bone is from a fish.

example.english: This fish has lots of fishbones, so be careful in case you swallow a bone.
example.traditional: 呢條魚好多魚骨，食嗰陣小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 hou2 do1 jyu4 gwat1 sik6 go2 zan6 siu2 sam1 di1
